class.name: ParallelogramVoxelEdit4D
class.brief_description: An edit that fills a transformed hypercube with one material.
class.description: ParallelogramVoxelEdit4D fills a box, which may be rotated and skewed, with a material. It is specified as the image of the unit hypercube under a 4D transform the region spanned by the columns of [member basis], starting at [member position]. A singular basis encloses no volume and fills nothing.

members.member: The basis whose columns span the filled region's edges, in voxel coordinates.
The material the region is filled with: [code]254[/code] for air, carving matter out, or [code]0[/code] to [code]253[/code] for the opaque materials, adding matter.
The corner of the filled region that the basis columns extend from, in voxel coordinates.
